paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the Recall@10 values for different variants of a conversation recommendation model on the INSPIRED dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories "Ours", "-critiquing", "-scoring", and "-ranking", representing different model configurations. The vertical axis is labeled with a scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1, and has no specified units. The bars are colored orange for "Ours" and blue for the other categories. The bar for "Ours" reaches approximately 0.35, while "-critiquing" reaches around 0.29, "-ranking" is at about 0.22, and "-scoring" is at approximately 0.16. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there is no additional visual emphasis on any of the bars. The grouping of bars is simple, with each category represented by a single bar.
